title.narrative: Supporting Capacity of CSOs in the field of Climate Change and Biodiversity

description.narrative:
This activity will focus on reinforcing and increasing the capacities of rights-based CSOs (including grassroots organisations, community-based organisations, local initiatives, national, regional or local CSOs, networks and platforms) working on environment and climate change issues in line with the European Green Deal framework. The activity will be carried out in indirect management with an entrusted entity modality and will include financial support to third parties. The intermediary organisation will also act as a vector for delivering targeted capacity building trainings as well as carrying out monitoring and evaluation of the grants, compilation of lessons learnt, scaling-up and replication potentials, ensuring higher visibility and overall management of the programme. Expected results include improved organisational and implementation capacities of CSOs, improved visibility and advocacy capacity for grassroots organisations, increased involvement of citizens and smaller CSOs in the environment and climate action related policy making at the local and national level, implemented demonstrations of innovative or key activities and enhanced partnerships among CSOs, business community and local and national actors. Development and dissemination of knowledge products shall also be targeted as possible.
